title: Mustard chicken with spring greens
summary: Mustard chicken with spring greens is a british dinner built around skinless chicken breast fillets and kale, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat skinless chicken breast fillets dry and season it. Prep kale and gluten-free Dijon mustard for Mustard chicken with spring greens so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook skinless chicken breast fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook kale and gluten-free Dijon mustard in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Mustard chicken with spring greens before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice skinless chicken breast fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
